name: Gympie
aboutDesc: Brought to you by the Gympie Regional Council and operated by shop local experts Why Leave Town, the Gympie Gift Card is aimed at encouraging people to shop local. Each card that is purchased can only be spent in local participating businesses...meaning all the money stays local!

name: Gympie - Business
aboutDesc: Welcome to the Gympie Gift Card Business Hub. This dedicated platform is designed to provide participating businesses with all the essential information and resources you need to successfully promote and utilize the Gympie Gift Card.
